method.method_draft: Trace the arrowed route in the diagram from X to Y. The path is made of five full cube-edge-length stretches on the surface: down the left vertical edge, across the lower front edge, up the next vertical edge, across the top/right edge portion to the upper right corner, and down the right vertical edge to Y. From the text, each cube edge is 18 cm, so the walking distance is 5 × 18 = 90 cm.

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct route-length counting method: it uses the drawn path as a sequence of full side-length surface segments rather than unfolding the cube or finding a shortest path.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the arrowed path on the cube and count the five full side-length stretches from X to Y.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the given side length of the cube, 18 cm, and the request for total walking distance.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: All edges of a cube have equal length, and the total distance along a piecewise route is the sum of its segment lengths; perspective foreshortening in the drawing does not change actual edge length.
